events.headline: United Airlines Blocks AI Agents
events.description: United Airlines has announced a ban on AI agents for booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks. This decision reflects growing concerns about data security in the travel industry, which could influence how Indian travel agencies and airlines adapt their digital strategies.
events.indiaRelevance: Indian travel agencies may need to enhance security measures to maintain customer trust.

analysis.bottomLine: United's move may set a precedent for the industry.
analysis.commercialImpact: Travel agencies might face increased operational costs due to enhanced security protocols.
analysis.winnersAndPressure: Agencies investing in security win, while those lagging may lose customers.
